tables.name: schemes
tables.title: Schemes & Estates
tables.description: Every scheme, estate and block Silvering owns or manages, with type, age, storeys, lifts and the patch housing officer.

tables.name: properties
tables.title: Property Register
tables.description: All 1,840 homes: address, scheme, tenure, type, bedrooms, heating, EPC, Decent Homes status, current rent and service charge.

columns.name: property_type
columns.expr: ('Bedsit' if rnd.random() < 0.08 else 'Flat') if scheme_type.startswith('Sheltered') else 'Flat' if scheme_type in ('General needs block', 'Sheltered (SilverLiving)', 'Extra care (SilverLiving)', 'Supported housing', 'Market rent') else rnd.choices(['House', 'Flat', 'Maisonette', 'Bungalow'], [55, 28, 11, 6])[0] if scheme_type == 'General needs estate' else rnd.choices(['House', 'Bungalow', 'Flat'], [72, 16, 12])[0] if scheme_type == 'Street properties' else rnd.choices(['House', 'Flat'], [45, 55])[0]

columns.name: bedrooms
columns.expr: 0 if property_type == 'Bedsit' else rnd.choices([1, 2], [88, 12])[0] if 'SilverLiving' in scheme_type or scheme_type == 'Supported housing' else rnd.choices([1, 2, 3], [45, 45, 10])[0] if property_type == 'Flat' else rnd.choices([2, 3], [60, 40])[0] if property_type == 'Maisonette' else rnd.choices([1, 2], [55, 45])[0] if property_type == 'Bungalow' else rnd.choices([2, 3, 4], [34, 56, 10])[0]

columns.name: address_line1
columns.expr: ('Flat ' + str(item + 1) + ', ' + base['scheme_name']) if property_type in ('Flat', 'Bedsit', 'Maisonette') and scheme_type != 'Street properties' else (str(rnd.randint(1, 140)) + ' ' + fake.street_name()) if scheme_type == 'Street properties' else (str(item + 1) + ' ' + base['scheme_name'])

columns.name: postcode
columns.expr: base['postcode_sector'] + choice('ABDEFGHJLNPQRSTUWXYZ') + choice('ABDEFGHJLNPQRSTUWXYZ')

columns.name: tenure
columns.expr: ('Leasehold' if rnd.random() < 0.15 else 'Social rent') if scheme_type == 'General needs block' else rnd.choices(['Social rent', 'Leasehold', 'Affordable rent'], [89, 7, 4])[0] if scheme_type == 'General needs estate' else ('Leasehold' if rnd.random() < 0.03 else 'Social rent') if scheme_type == 'Street properties' else 'Older persons & supported' if 'SilverLiving' in scheme_type or scheme_type == 'Supported housing' else 'Market rent' if scheme_type == 'Market rent' else rnd.choices(['Social rent', 'Affordable rent', 'Shared ownership'], [31, 40, 29])[0] if scheme_id == 'SCH14' else rnd.choices(['Affordable rent', 'Shared ownership'], [68, 32])[0]

columns.name: storeys
columns.expr: base['max_storeys'] if property_type in ('Flat', 'Bedsit', 'Maisonette') else (1 if property_type == 'Bungalow' else 2)

columns.name: heating
columns.expr: 'Air source heat pump' if build_year >= 2022 else 'Electric storage heaters' if scheme_id == 'SCH01' or rnd.random() < 0.04 else rnd.choices(['Gas combi boiler', 'Gas system boiler'], [84, 16])[0]

columns.name: has_gas
columns.expr: heating.startswith('Gas')

columns.name: epc_rating
columns.expr: rnd.choices(['A', 'B'], [40, 60])[0] if build_year >= 2022 else rnd.choices(['B', 'C', 'A'], [72, 22, 6])[0] if build_year >= 2005 else rnd.choices(['C', 'B', 'D'], [70, 8, 22])[0] if build_year >= 1980 else rnd.choices(['C', 'D', 'E'], [44, 46, 10])[0] if build_year >= 1950 else rnd.choices(['C', 'D', 'E', 'F'], [25, 50, 20, 5])[0]

columns.name: last_stock_survey
columns.expr: None if build_year >= 2024 or rnd.random() < 0.08 else (d('2021-05-01') + timedelta(days=rnd.randint(0, 1980))).date().isoformat()

columns.name: weekly_rent
columns.expr: round(0.0, 2) if tenure == 'Leasehold' else round(104 + 13 * bedrooms + rnd.uniform(-5, 6) if tenure == 'Social rent' else 158 + 31 * bedrooms + rnd.uniform(-8, 10) if tenure == 'Affordable rent' else 60 + 14 * bedrooms + rnd.uniform(-6, 8) if tenure == 'Shared ownership' else 106 + 7 * bedrooms + rnd.uniform(-4, 5) if tenure == 'Older persons & supported' else 215 + 74 * bedrooms + rnd.uniform(-10, 15), 2)

columns.name: weekly_service_charge
columns.expr: round(rnd.uniform(34, 58), 2) if scheme_type == 'Extra care (SilverLiving)' else round(rnd.uniform(24, 36), 2) if 'SilverLiving' in scheme_type or scheme_type == 'Supported housing' else round(rnd.uniform(12, 24), 2) if property_type in ('Flat', 'Maisonette', 'Bedsit') and scheme_type != 'Street properties' else round(rnd.uniform(1.2, 3.5), 2) if scheme_type in ('General needs estate', 'New build mixed tenure') else 0.0

columns.name: status
columns.expr: 'New build - awaiting let' if scheme_id == 'SCH14' and item >= 44 else 'Occupied'

columns.name: repair_weight
columns.expr: 2.6 if scheme_id == 'SCH03' else 0.25 if tenure in ('Leasehold', 'Shared ownership') else 0.5 if build_year >= 2022 else 1.4 if scheme_id == 'SCH01' else 0.8 if tenure == 'Market rent' else 1.0

columns.name: damp_weight
columns.expr: 0 if tenure in ('Leasehold', 'Shared ownership') else 5.0 if scheme_id == 'SCH03' else 2.5 if scheme_id == 'SCH01' else 2.0 if scheme_id == 'SCH21' else 1.3 if build_year < 1980 else 0.3 if build_year >= 2010 else 0.8

tables.name: employees
tables.title: Staff Directory
tables.description: All Silvering employees with role, team, manager, base, trade (for operatives), contract and salary. Confidential: contains salary data.

columns.name: full_name
columns.expr: fake.first_name() + ' ' + fake.last_name()

columns.name: job_title
columns.expr: ["Multi-trade Operative (Plumbing)", "Multi-trade Operative (Plumbing)", "Multi-trade Operative (Plumbing)", "Electrician", "Electrician", "Gas Engineer", "Gas Engineer", "Gas Engineer", "Carpenter", "Carpenter", "Carpenter", "Operative Decorator (Damp & Mould)", "Operative Decorator (Damp & Mould)", "Plasterer", "Multi-trade Operative", "Multi-trade Operative", "Multi-trade Operative", "Clearance Operative (Voids)", "Clearance Operative (Voids)", "Repairs Planner", "Customer Service Adviser", "Customer Service Adviser", "Customer Service Adviser", "Customer Service Adviser", "SilverLiving Scheme Officer", "Finance Assistant", "IT Support Analyst"][int(employee_id[1:]) - 1001]

columns.name: department
columns.expr: ["repairs", "repairs", "repairs", "repairs", "repairs", "repairs", "repairs", "repairs", "repairs", "repairs", "repairs", "repairs", "repairs", "repairs", "repairs", "repairs", "repairs", "repairs", "repairs", "repairs", "customer", "customer", "customer", "customer", "tenancy", "finance", "people"][int(employee_id[1:]) - 1001]

columns.name: location
columns.expr: 'Field-based' if department == 'repairs' and 'Planner' not in job_title else ('Aylesford depot' if department == 'repairs' else ('Linton Lodge' if department == 'tenancy' else 'Maidstone'))

columns.name: email
columns.expr: full_name.lower().replace(' ', '.').replace("'", '') + '@silvering-homes.org.uk'

columns.name: trade
columns.expr: 'Plumbing' if 'Plumbing' in job_title else 'Electrical' if 'Electric' in job_title else 'Gas & heating' if 'Gas' in job_title else 'Carpentry' if 'Carpenter' in job_title else 'Damp & mould' if 'Damp & Mould)' in job_title or 'Plasterer' in job_title else 'Multi-trade' if job_title == 'Multi-trade Operative' else 'Voids clearance' if 'Clearance' in job_title else None

columns.name: contract
columns.expr: 'Fixed term' if rnd.random() < 0.06 else 'Permanent'

columns.name: fte
columns.expr: rnd.choice([0.6, 0.8]) if rnd.random() < 0.14 and trade is None else 1.0

columns.name: salary_gbp
columns.expr: {'P001': 128000, 'P002': 104000, 'P003': 98000, 'P004': 98000, 'P005': 96000, 'P006': 18000}.get(employee_id) or (rnd.randint(52, 64) * 1000 if 'Head of' in job_title else rnd.randint(42, 50) * 1000 if 'Manager' in job_title or 'Controller' in job_title else rnd.randint(34, 41) * 1000 if trade or 'Surveyor' in job_title or 'Officer' in job_title else rnd.randint(25, 31) * 1000)

columns.name: status
columns.expr: 'Active'

tables.name: voids
tables.title: Void Properties
tables.description: Every empty home (relets) since November 2024: why it became empty, void type, works and let dates, days empty and rent lost.

columns.name: uprn
columns.filter: ref['tenure'] not in ('Leasehold', 'Shared ownership') and ref['scheme_id'] != 'SCH14'

columns.name: void_reason
columns.expr: rnd.choices(['Death of tenant', 'Transfer to another Silvering home', 'Moved to another landlord or private', 'Moved into care', 'Abandonment', 'Eviction', 'Other'], [26, 20, 18, 12, 7, 5, 12])[0] if tenure != 'Older persons & supported' else rnd.choices(['Death of tenant', 'Moved into care', 'Moved to family', 'Other'], [52, 30, 12, 6])[0]

columns.name: void_type
columns.expr: 'Major works' if (void_reason in ('Death of tenant', 'Abandonment', 'Eviction') and rnd.random() < 0.5) or rnd.random() < 0.12 else 'Standard'

columns.name: works_completed
columns.expr: (lambda x: None if x > as_of else x.date().isoformat())(d(void_start) + timedelta(days=max(4, int(rnd.gauss(38, 12) if void_type == 'Major works' else rnd.gauss(14, 5)))))

columns.name: let_date
columns.expr: None if works_completed is None else (lambda x: None if x > as_of else x.date().isoformat())(d(works_completed) + timedelta(days=max(1, int(rnd.gauss(7, 4) + (7 if void_start >= '2026-05-01' else 0)))))

columns.name: status
columns.expr: 'Let' if let_date else ('Ready to let' if works_completed else 'Works in progress')

columns.name: days_void
columns.expr: ((d(let_date) if let_date else as_of) - d(void_start)).days

columns.name: rent_loss_gbp
columns.expr: round((weekly_rent or 0) / 7 * days_void, 2)

tables.name: tenancies
tables.title: Tenancies & Households
tables.description: Current tenancies and leases: lead tenant, tenancy type, start date, household, vulnerability and Universal Credit. Confidential: personal and special category data.
tables.where: status == 'Occupied' and uprn not in {v['uprn'] for v in tables['voids'] if v['status'] != 'Let'}

columns.name: tenancy_type
columns.expr: {'Shared ownership': 'Shared ownership lease', 'Market rent': 'Assured periodic (market rent)', 'Leasehold': 'Long lease (right to buy)'}.get(tenure, 'Assured')

columns.name: start_date
columns.expr: (d('2026-10-05') + timedelta(days=rnd.randint(0, 24))).date().isoformat() if base['scheme_id'] == 'SCH14' else (lambda lo: (lo + timedelta(days=int((as_of - lo).days * (rnd.random() ** 0.8) * 0.98))).date().isoformat())(d(str(max(base['build_year'], 1976)) + '-03-01'))

columns.name: lead_tenant
columns.expr: fake.first_name() + ' ' + fake.last_name()

columns.name: lead_tenant_age
columns.expr: rnd.randint(58, 96) if tenure == 'Older persons & supported' and base['scheme_id'] != 'SCH13' else rnd.randint(19, 45) if base['scheme_id'] == 'SCH13' else rnd.randint(24, 62) if tenure == 'Market rent' else max(19, min(92, int(rnd.gauss(49, 16))))

columns.name: household_size
columns.expr: rnd.choices([1, 2], [82, 18])[0] if tenure == 'Older persons & supported' else rnd.choices([1, 2, 3, 4], [40, 35, 18, 7])[0] if base['property_type'] != 'House' else rnd.choices([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], [10, 22, 28, 24, 11, 5])[0]

columns.name: children_in_household
columns.expr: household_size >= 3 and lead_tenant_age < 60 and rnd.random() < 0.8

columns.name: vulnerability_flag
columns.expr: rnd.random() < (0.55 if tenure == 'Older persons & supported' else 0.17)

columns.name: vulnerability_type
columns.expr: rnd.choice(['Mobility', 'Mental health', 'Respiratory condition', 'Hearing or sight', 'Learning disability', 'Domestic abuse survivor', 'Frailty']) if vulnerability_flag else None

columns.name: universal_credit
columns.expr: tenure in ('Social rent', 'Affordable rent', 'Market rent', 'Older persons & supported') and lead_tenant_age < 66 and rnd.random() < (0.47 if tenure == 'Affordable rent' else 0.12 if tenure == 'Market rent' else 0.6 if base['scheme_id'] == 'SCH13' else 0.4)

columns.name: apa_in_place
columns.expr: universal_credit and rnd.random() < 0.28

columns.name: contact_preference
columns.expr: rnd.choices(['Phone', 'Letter', 'Email', 'MySilvering app'], [55, 30, 10, 5])[0] if lead_tenant_age >= 70 else rnd.choices(['Phone', 'Email', 'MySilvering app', 'Letter'], [42, 26, 24, 8])[0]

columns.name: email
columns.expr: None if contact_preference in ('Letter',) and rnd.random() < 0.7 else lead_tenant.lower().replace(' ', '.').replace("'", '') + str(rnd.randint(1, 99)) + '@' + choice(['example.com', 'example.net', 'example.org'])

columns.name: status
columns.expr: 'Notice given' if rnd.random() < 0.012 else 'Current'

columns.name: complaint_weight
columns.expr: 2.6 if base['scheme_id'] == 'SCH03' else 1.6 if base['scheme_id'] in ('SCH01', 'SCH14') else 1.0

tables.name: rent_accounts
tables.title: Rent Accounts
tables.description: One account per tenancy or lease: weekly charge, current balance (positive = arrears), recovery stage, Universal Credit/APA, last payment and income officer.

columns.name: weekly_charge
columns.expr: round((base['weekly_rent'] or 0) + (base['weekly_service_charge'] or 0), 2)

columns.name: balance_gbp
columns.expr: (lambda p: round(weekly_charge * (min(26, rnd.expovariate(1 / 4.6)) + 0.3), 2) if rnd.random() < p else (-round(weekly_charge * rnd.uniform(0, 1.6), 2) if rnd.random() < 0.45 else 0.0))(0.5 if universal_credit and not apa_in_place else 0.34 if universal_credit else 0.07 if tenure == 'Older persons & supported' else 0.1 if tenure in ('Leasehold', 'Shared ownership') else 0.18)

columns.name: weeks_in_arrears
columns.expr: round(balance_gbp / weekly_charge, 1) if balance_gbp > 0 and weekly_charge else 0.0

columns.name: arrears_band
columns.expr: 'No arrears' if balance_gbp <= 0 else 'Under £250' if balance_gbp < 250 else '£250 - £999' if balance_gbp < 1000 else '£1,000 - £2,499' if balance_gbp < 2500 else '£2,500 and over'

columns.name: recovery_stage
columns.expr: 'None' if balance_gbp <= 0 else 'Early contact' if weeks_in_arrears < 1 else 'Stage 1 - letter' if weeks_in_arrears < 3 else rnd.choice(['Payment arrangement', 'Stage 2 - call and visit']) if weeks_in_arrears < 7 else rnd.choice(['Payment arrangement', 'NOSP served', 'Hardship referral']) if weeks_in_arrears < 13 else rnd.choice(['NOSP served', 'Court action pending', 'Suspended possession order'])

columns.name: last_payment_date
columns.expr: (as_of - timedelta(days=rnd.randint(1, 13) if balance_gbp <= 0 else rnd.randint(3, 20) if weeks_in_arrears < 6 else rnd.randint(10, 75))).date().isoformat()

columns.name: income_officer
columns.expr: choice(['Ryan Tait', 'Priya Chauhan', 'Sam Odukoya'])

tables.name: repairs
tables.title: Responsive Repairs
tables.description: Every responsive repair reported since November 2024: trade, priority, target and completion dates, operative or contractor, cost, first-time fix and resident feedback.

columns.name: reported_date
columns.expr: (lambda x: x if x.weekday() < 5 or rnd.random() < 0.3 else x - timedelta(days=x.weekday() - 4))(d('2024-11-04') + timedelta(days=rnd.randint(0, 730), hours=rnd.randint(7, 19), minutes=rnd.choice([0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50])) if build_year < 2026 else d('2026-10-06') + timedelta(days=rnd.randint(0, 29), hours=rnd.randint(8, 17))).strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:00')

columns.name: channel
columns.expr: rnd.choices(['Phone', 'MySilvering portal', 'Email', 'Operative-raised', 'Housing officer'], [54, 23, 10, 8, 5])[0]

columns.name: trade
columns.expr: rnd.choices(["Plumbing", "Heating & gas", "Electrical", "Carpentry", "Windows & doors", "Damp & mould", "Roofing", "Plastering", "Drainage", "Fencing & external", "General"], [20, 12, 12, 14, 8, 6 if build_year >= 1980 else 10, 5, 6, 5, 6, 4])[0]

columns.name: description
columns.expr: choice({"Plumbing": ["Leaking tap in kitchen", "Toilet not flushing", "Leak under bath", "Blocked sink", "Water coming through ceiling from flat above", "Dripping overflow pipe", "Shower not working", "Burst pipe in airing cupboard"], "Heating & gas": ["No heating or hot water", "Boiler losing pressure", "Radiator cold at top", "Boiler making loud banging noise", "Thermostat not working", "Smell of gas reported (made safe)"], "Electrical": ["Sockets not working in bedroom", "Light fitting not working in hallway", "Extractor fan not working in bathroom", "Smoke alarm beeping", "Electric shower tripping", "Exposed wiring at light switch"], "Carpentry": ["Front door not locking", "Kitchen cupboard door hanging off", "Internal door sticking", "Loose stair handrail", "Skirting board damaged", "Window board rotten"], "Windows & doors": ["Window will not close", "Condensation between double-glazed panes", "Back door seal letting in draught", "Broken window catch (child safety)", "Patio door off its runners"], "Damp & mould": ["Black mould on bedroom wall", "Mould around bathroom window", "Damp patch on living room ceiling", "Musty smell and mould in child's bedroom", "Condensation running down windows every morning"], "Roofing": ["Roof leak into loft", "Slipped roof tiles", "Gutter overflowing", "Flat roof leaking over kitchen", "Fascia board loose"], "Plastering": ["Crack in ceiling plaster", "Plaster blown behind tiles", "Hole in wall after leak", "Ceiling repair after water damage"], "Drainage": ["Blocked outside drain", "Smell from drain", "Gully overflowing", "Shared drain blocked (block)"], "Fencing & external": ["Fence panel blown down", "Path slab uneven (trip hazard)", "Gate broken", "Communal bin store door broken", "Outside light not working"], "General": ["Pre-tenancy inspection follow-up", "Install grab rail", "Replace bath panel", "Ease and adjust doors", "Make good after adaptation"]}[trade])

columns.name: priority
columns.expr: 'Emergency' if description in ('No heating or hot water', 'Smell of gas reported (made safe)', 'Water coming through ceiling from flat above', 'Burst pipe in airing cupboard', 'Exposed wiring at light switch', 'Front door not locking') and rnd.random() < 0.85 else rnd.choices(['Emergency', 'Urgent', 'Routine', 'Planned'], [6, 24, 64, 6])[0]

columns.name: target_date
columns.expr: (d(reported_date) + timedelta(days={"Emergency": 1, "Urgent": 7, "Routine": 28, "Planned": 90}[priority])).date().isoformat()

columns.name: completed_date
columns.expr: (lambda x: x.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:00'))(d(reported_date) + timedelta(hours=(rnd.uniform(1, 20) if rnd.random() < 0.93 else rnd.uniform(24, 60)) if priority == 'Emergency' else timedelta(days=max(0.2, (rnd.gauss(4.6, 2.4) if priority == 'Urgent' else rnd.gauss(16, 8) if priority == 'Routine' else rnd.gauss(55, 22)) + (rnd.uniform(0, 14) if scheme_id == 'SCH03' and priority in ('Routine', 'Urgent') else 0) + (rnd.uniform(0, 17) if priority == 'Routine' and reported_date >= '2026-05-01' else 0) + (rnd.uniform(0, 12) if trade == 'Electrical' and reported_date >= '2026-03-01' and priority != 'Emergency' else 0) + (rnd.uniform(0, 6) if trade in ('Damp & mould', 'Roofing') else 0))).total_seconds() / 3600))

columns.name: status
columns.expr: 'Cancelled' if rnd.random() < 0.03 else ('Completed' if d(completed_date) <= as_of else rnd.choices(['Open', 'Appointment booked', 'Awaiting parts', 'Awaiting contractor'], [40, 38, 14, 8])[0])

columns.name: days_to_complete
columns.expr: round((d(completed_date) - d(reported_date)).total_seconds() / 86400, 1) if status == 'Completed' else None

columns.name: in_target
columns.expr: (d(completed_date).date() <= d(target_date).date()) if status == 'Completed' else None

columns.name: overdue
columns.expr: status not in ('Completed', 'Cancelled') and as_of.date() > d(target_date).date()

columns.name: contractor
columns.expr: ('Weald Roofing & Guttering Ltd' if trade == 'Roofing' else 'ClearFlow Drainage Ltd') if trade in ('Roofing', 'Drainage') else ('Brightline Electrical Ltd' if trade == 'Electrical' and reported_date >= '2026-03-01' and rnd.random() < 0.3 else None)

columns.name: operative
columns.expr: None if contractor else (lambda pool: choice(pool) if pool else None)([e['full_name'] for e in tables['employees'] if e['trade'] == {'Plumbing': 'Plumbing', 'Heating & gas': 'Gas & heating', 'Electrical': 'Electrical', 'Carpentry': 'Carpentry', 'Windows & doors': 'Carpentry', 'Damp & mould': 'Damp & mould', 'Plastering': 'Damp & mould', 'Fencing & external': 'Multi-trade', 'General': 'Multi-trade'}.get(trade)])

columns.name: cost_gbp
columns.expr: round(max(18, rnd.gauss({'Plumbing': 95, 'Heating & gas': 140, 'Electrical': 110, 'Carpentry': 120, 'Windows & doors': 160, 'Damp & mould': 340, 'Roofing': 420, 'Plastering': 210, 'Drainage': 180, 'Fencing & external': 150, 'General': 90}[trade], 40)) * (1.25 if contractor else 1), 2) if status == 'Completed' else None

columns.name: first_time_fix
columns.expr: (rnd.random() < (0.62 if scheme_id == 'SCH03' else 0.79)) if status == 'Completed' else None

columns.name: resident_rating
columns.expr: (rnd.choices([5, 4, 3, 2, 1], [44, 26, 12, 9, 9] if in_target and first_time_fix else [16, 20, 20, 20, 24])[0]) if status == 'Completed' and rnd.random() < 0.28 else None

tables.name: damp_mould_cases
tables.title: Damp & Mould Cases
tables.description: Damp and mould reports since November 2024 with hazard level, investigation, written summary and works dates. Cases from 27 October 2025 are covered by Awaab's Law timescales.

columns.name: reported_date
columns.expr: (lambda days: rnd.choices(days, [[1.7, 1.8, 1.5, 1.0, 0.6, 0.5, 0.45, 0.5, 0.7, 1.1, 1.5, 1.8][x.month - 1] for x in days])[0].date().isoformat())([d('2024-11-04') + timedelta(days=k) for k in range(0, 730) if (d('2024-11-04') + timedelta(days=k)).weekday() < 5])

columns.name: source
columns.expr: rnd.choices(['Repair report', 'Housing officer visit', 'MySilvering', 'Complaint', 'Operative-raised', 'TSM survey', 'Councillor or MP'], [44, 15, 14, 9, 9, 5, 4])[0]

columns.name: hazard_level
columns.expr: rnd.choices(['Emergency', 'Significant', 'Not significant'], [7, 58 + (10 if children_in_household or vulnerability_flag else 0), 35])[0]

columns.name: awaabs_law
columns.expr: reported_date >= '2025-10-27'

columns.name: investigation_due
columns.expr: (d(reported_date) + timedelta(days=1)).date().isoformat() if hazard_level == 'Emergency' else (lambda s, n: s + timedelta(days=(n//5)*7 + n%5 + (2 if s.weekday() + n%5 >= 5 else 0)))(d(reported_date), 10).date().isoformat()

columns.name: investigated_date
columns.expr: (lambda x: None if x > as_of else x.date().isoformat())(d(reported_date) + timedelta(days=((0 if rnd.random() < 0.85 else rnd.randint(1, 3)) if hazard_level == 'Emergency' else max(1, int(rnd.gauss(7, 3) + (rnd.uniform(0, 9) if scheme_id == 'SCH03' else 0) + (rnd.uniform(0, 5) if reported_date >= '2026-06-01' else 0))) if awaabs_law else max(2, int(rnd.gauss(16, 8))))))

columns.name: summary_due
columns.expr: (lambda s, n: s + timedelta(days=(n//5)*7 + n%5 + (2 if s.weekday() + n%5 >= 5 else 0)))(d(investigated_date), 3).date().isoformat() if investigated_date else None

columns.name: summary_sent_date
columns.expr: None if not investigated_date or (awaabs_law and rnd.random() < 0.03) else (lambda x: None if x > as_of else x.date().isoformat())(d(investigated_date) + timedelta(days=rnd.choices([0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 9, 14], [16, 32, 24, 12, 7, 4, 3, 2])[0]))

columns.name: works_due
columns.expr: (None if hazard_level == 'Not significant' or not investigated_date else (d(investigated_date) + timedelta(days=1)).date().isoformat() if hazard_level == 'Emergency' else (lambda s, n: s + timedelta(days=(n//5)*7 + n%5 + (2 if s.weekday() + n%5 >= 5 else 0)))(d(investigated_date), 5).date().isoformat())

columns.name: works_started_date
columns.expr: None if not works_due else (lambda x: None if x > as_of else x.date().isoformat())(d(investigated_date) + timedelta(days=(rnd.choice([0, 0, 1, 1, 2]) if hazard_level == 'Emergency' else max(1, int(rnd.gauss(4, 2) + (rnd.uniform(0, 7) if scheme_id == 'SCH03' else 0))))))

columns.name: works_completed_date
columns.expr: None if not works_started_date else (lambda x: None if x > as_of else x.date().isoformat())(d(works_started_date) + timedelta(days=max(1, int(rnd.gauss(12, 8)))))

columns.name: cause
columns.expr: rnd.choices(['Condensation (ventilation)', 'Penetrating damp', 'Plumbing leak', 'Roof or gutter defect', 'Rising damp', 'Cold bridging / insulation'], [44, 18, 13, 12, 5, 8])[0]

columns.name: surveyor
columns.expr: ('Marcus Adebayo' if rnd.random() < 0.45 else 'Ellie Novak') if reported_date >= '2025-09-15' else 'Ellie Novak'

columns.name: alternative_accommodation
columns.expr: 'Decant to temporary accommodation' if hazard_level == 'Emergency' and rnd.random() < 0.35 else None

columns.name: status
columns.expr: 'Open - awaiting investigation' if not investigated_date else 'Open - works in progress' if works_due and not works_completed_date else 'Open - awaiting written summary' if not summary_sent_date else 'Closed'

columns.name: timescale_breach
columns.expr: None if not awaabs_law else (lambda r: '; '.join(r) or None)([m for m, bad in [('Investigation late', (d(investigated_date) if investigated_date else as_of).date() > d(investigation_due).date()), ('Written summary late', bool(investigated_date) and (d(summary_sent_date) if summary_sent_date else as_of).date() > d(summary_due).date()), ('Safety works start late', bool(works_due) and (d(works_started_date) if works_started_date else as_of).date() > d(works_due).date())] if bad])

tables.name: complaints
tables.title: Complaints Register
tables.description: All formal complaints since November 2024 under the Complaint Handling Code: stage 1 and stage 2 dates and targets, outcome, compensation and Housing Ombudsman referrals.

columns.name: channel
columns.expr: rnd.choices(['Phone', 'Email', 'MySilvering', 'Letter', 'In person', 'Councillor or MP'], [38, 26, 20, 5, 5, 6])[0]

columns.name: category
columns.expr: rnd.choices(["Repairs - delay", "Repairs - quality", "Damp & mould", "Communication", "Anti-social behaviour handling", "Staff conduct", "Rent & service charges", "Estate services & cleaning", "Lettings & transfers", "New build defects"], [24, 12, 15 if scheme_id != 'SCH03' else 40, 12, 8, 5, 6, 8, 4, 0 if scheme_id not in ('SCH14', 'SCH25') else 40])[0]

columns.name: summary
columns.expr: choice({"Repairs - delay": ["Waited weeks for a leak repair; three missed appointments", "Heating repair still not done after operative said parts were ordered", "Routine repair booked and cancelled twice without notice"], "Repairs - quality": ["Repair had to be redone three times", "Operative left mess and did not finish the job", "Window replaced but still lets in water"], "Damp & mould": ["Mould keeps coming back after treatment; child has asthma", "Told it was condensation and to open windows; no inspection", "No written update after damp inspection"], "Communication": ["Nobody returns calls or emails", "Letter sent to wrong name after bereavement", "Promised call-back did not happen"], "Anti-social behaviour handling": ["Reported noise for months and nothing done", "Case closed without telling me", "Feel unsafe and officer has not visited"], "Staff conduct": ["Adviser was rude on the phone", "Operative was dismissive about my disability", "Officer discussed my case in front of neighbours"], "Rent & service charges": ["Service charge increase not explained", "Payment not credited to rent account", "Threatening arrears letter sent while UC claim was pending"], "Estate services & cleaning": ["Communal areas not cleaned for weeks", "Grass not cut and bins overflowing", "Lift out of order repeatedly"], "Lettings & transfers": ["Transfer request ignored", "Home not ready on move-in day", "Not told why bid was unsuccessful"], "New build defects": ["Snagging items still outstanding after move-in", "Heat pump controls not explained and bills high", "Front door does not seal properly"]}[category])

columns.name: ack_due
columns.expr: (lambda s, n: s + timedelta(days=(n//5)*7 + n%5 + (2 if s.weekday() + n%5 >= 5 else 0)))(d(received_date), 5).date().isoformat()

columns.name: ack_date
columns.expr: (lambda x: None if x > as_of else x.date().isoformat())(d(received_date) + timedelta(days=rnd.choices([0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 9], [20, 30, 20, 12, 9, 6, 3])[0]))

columns.name: stage1_due
columns.expr: (lambda s, n: s + timedelta(days=(n//5)*7 + n%5 + (2 if s.weekday() + n%5 >= 5 else 0)))(d(ack_date), 10).date().isoformat() if ack_date else None

columns.name: stage1_response_date
columns.expr: None if not ack_date else (lambda x: None if x > as_of else x.date().isoformat())(d(ack_date) + timedelta(days=max(1, int(rnd.gauss(11, 4.5) + (rnd.uniform(0, 9) if '2026-06-01' <= received_date < '2026-10-01' else 0) + (rnd.uniform(0, 5) if category.startswith('Repairs') or category == 'Damp & mould' else 0)))))

columns.name: stage1_in_target
columns.expr: (d(stage1_response_date).date() <= d(stage1_due).date()) if stage1_response_date else None

columns.name: stage1_outcome
columns.expr: rnd.choices(['Upheld', 'Partly upheld', 'Not upheld'], [42, 32, 26] if category in ('Repairs - delay', 'Damp & mould', 'Communication') else [28, 30, 42])[0] if stage1_response_date else None

columns.name: compensation_gbp
columns.expr: (rnd.choices([0, 50, 75, 100, 150, 250, 400, 650], [16, 18, 14, 18, 12, 10, 8, 4])[0] if stage1_outcome in ('Upheld', 'Partly upheld') else 0) if stage1_response_date else None

columns.name: escalated_stage2
columns.expr: bool(stage1_response_date) and rnd.random() < (0.12 if stage1_outcome == 'Upheld' else 0.3)

columns.name: stage2_received
columns.expr: (lambda x: None if x > as_of else x.date().isoformat())(d(stage1_response_date) + timedelta(days=rnd.randint(2, 21))) if escalated_stage2 else None

columns.name: stage2_due
columns.expr: (lambda s, n: s + timedelta(days=(n//5)*7 + n%5 + (2 if s.weekday() + n%5 >= 5 else 0)))(d(stage2_received), 25).date().isoformat() if stage2_received else None

columns.name: stage2_response_date
columns.expr: None if not stage2_received else (lambda x: None if x > as_of else x.date().isoformat())(d(stage2_received) + timedelta(days=max(5, int(rnd.gauss(30, 9)))))

columns.name: stage2_outcome
columns.expr: rnd.choices(['Upheld', 'Partly upheld', 'Not upheld'], [30, 35, 35])[0] if stage2_response_date else None

columns.name: ombudsman
columns.expr: (rnd.choices(['Referred - awaiting determination', 'Determined - maladministration', 'Determined - service failure', 'Determined - no maladministration'], [40, 20, 20, 20])[0] if rnd.random() < 0.32 else None) if stage2_response_date and stage2_response_date < '2026-09-01' else None

columns.name: handler
columns.expr: 'Owen Fletcher' if stage2_received else choice(['Mark Pennington', 'Mark Pennington', 'Leah Foster'])

columns.name: status
columns.expr: 'With Housing Ombudsman' if ombudsman == 'Referred - awaiting determination' else 'Open - stage 2' if stage2_received and not stage2_response_date else 'Open - stage 1' if not stage1_response_date else 'Closed'

columns.name: learning
columns.expr: choice(['Missed appointments: text reminder added', 'Damp follow-up visit now booked at inspection', 'Call-back promises logged as tasks in Keystone', 'Repairs history checked before stage 1 response', 'Bereavement name-change process reviewed', 'Contractor quality checks on 10% of jobs', None, None]) if stage1_outcome in ('Upheld', 'Partly upheld') else None

satisfied', 'Very satisfied') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(tp01_overall), 1) AS pct_positive FROM tsm_survey WHERE tp01_overall IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tsm_year, tenure_group UNION ALL SELECT tsm_year, tenure_group, 'TP02' AS measure_code, 'Satisfaction with repairs' AS measure, COUNT(tp02_repairs) AS responses, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN tp02_repairs IN ('Fairly satisfied', 'Very satisfied') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(tp02_repairs), 1) AS pct_positive FROM tsm_survey WHERE tp02_repairs IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tsm_year, tenure_group UNION ALL SELECT tsm_year, tenure_group, 'TP03' AS measure_code, 'Satisfaction with time taken to complete most recent repair' AS measure, COUNT(tp03_time_taken) AS responses, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN tp03_time_taken IN ('Fairly satisfied', 'Very satisfied') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(tp03_time_taken), 1) AS pct_positive FROM tsm_survey WHERE tp03_time_taken IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tsm_year, tenure_group UNION ALL SELECT tsm_year, tenure_group, 'TP04' AS measure_code, 'Satisfaction that the home is well maintained' AS measure, COUNT(tp04_well_maintained) AS responses, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN tp04_well_maintained IN ('Fairly satisfied', 'Very derived.name: monthly_repairs
derived.title: Monthly Repairs Performance
derived.description: Repairs reported and completed each month, % completed in target by priority, and average days for routine repairs.
derived.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT substr(completed_date, 1, 7) AS month, * FROM repairs WHERE status = 'Completed') SELECT m.month, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repairs r WHERE substr(r.reported_date, 1, 7) = m.month) AS reported, COUNT(*) AS completed, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(in_target), 1) AS pct_in_target, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN priority = 'Emergency' THEN in_target END), 1) AS emergency_pct, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN priority = 'Urgent' THEN in_target END), 1) AS urgent_pct, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN priority = 'Routine' THEN in_target END), 1) AS routine_pct, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN priority = 'Routine' THEN days_to_complete END), 1) AS routine_avg_days, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(first_time_fix), 1) AS first_time_fix_pct, ROUND(SUM(cost_gbp), 0) AS cost_gbp FROM (SELECT DISTINCT month FROM c WHERE month >= '2024-11' AND month <= '2026-10') m JOIN c USING (month) GROUP BY m.month ORDER BY m.month

derived.name: scheme_summary
derived.title: Scheme Performance Summary
derived.description: One row per scheme: homes, repairs and open/overdue repairs (last 12 months), damp cases, complaints, arrears and TSM overall satisfaction.
derived.sql: SELECT s.scheme_id, s.scheme_name, s.scheme_type, s.local_authority, s.homes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repairs r WHERE r.scheme_id = s.scheme_id AND r.reported_date >= '2025-11-05') AS repairs_12m, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repairs r WHERE r.scheme_id = s.scheme_id AND r.status NOT IN ('Completed', 'Cancelled')) AS open_repairs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repairs r WHERE r.scheme_id = s.scheme_id AND r.overdue = 1) AS overdue_repairs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM damp_mould_cases m WHERE m.scheme_id = s.scheme_id AND m.reported_date >= '2025-11-05') AS damp_cases_12m, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM damp_mould_cases m WHERE m.scheme_id = s.scheme_id AND m.status != 'Closed') AS open_damp_cases, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM complaints c WHERE c.scheme_id = s.scheme_id AND c.received_date >= '2025-11-05') AS complaints_12m, (SELECT ROUND(SUM(balance_gbp), 0) FROM rent_accounts a WHERE a.scheme_id = s.scheme_id AND a.balance_gbp > 0) AS arrears_gbp, (SELECT ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN tp01_overall IN ('Very satisfied', 'Fairly satisfied') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END), 1) FROM tsm_survey t WHERE t.scheme_id = s.scheme_id) AS tsm_overall_pct, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tsm_survey t WHERE t.scheme_id = s.scheme_id) AS tsm_responses FROM schemes s ORDER BY s.scheme_id

UPDATE properties SET status = 'Void' WHERE uprn IN (SELECT uprn FROM voids WHERE status != 'Let')

UPDATE tenancies SET start_date = (SELECT MAX(let_date) FROM voids v WHERE v.uprn = tenancies.uprn AND v.status = 'Let') WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM voids v WHERE v.uprn = tenancies.uprn AND v.status = 'Let')
UPDATE tenancies SET tenancy_type = 'Starter (12 months)' WHERE tenancy_type = 'Assured' AND tenure IN ('Social rent', 'Affordable rent') AND start_date >= '2025-11-05'
UPDATE properties SET decent_homes = 'No - serious hazard (damp and mould)' WHERE uprn IN (SELECT uprn FROM damp_mould_cases WHERE scheme_id = 'SCH03' AND status != 'Closed' ORDER BY case_id LIMIT 2)

UPDATE properties SET decent_homes = 'No - disrepair (roof)' WHERE uprn = (SELECT uprn FROM properties WHERE scheme_id = 'SCH03' AND property_type = 'House' AND decent_homes = 'Yes' AND tenure = 'Social rent' ORDER BY uprn LIMIT 1 OFFSET 40)
